name: Guillotine

abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Damage Reflect: Engellenen hasarın belirtilen kısmı, doğrudan hasar olarak rakibe geri gönderilir.
abilityDetails.Degeneration: Rakibe zamanla doğrudan, engellenemez hasar verir.

signatureAbility:
Cursed Aura
Whenever the opponent is Immune to Guillotine's personal Bleed effects, she has a [60 - 100]% chance to inflict a matching Rupture Debuff, causing Physical Damage. This Rupture Debuff grants 1 Soul Charge.

abilitySections.title: Always Active - Life Siphon
content: Guillotine Heals 3% of all damage taken by the opponent.

abilitySections.title: Soul Charges - Max Stacks: 15
content: Each time either Champion loses 5% of their Max Health or is inflicted with a Bleed effect, gain 1 Soul Charge. The first 10 Soul Charges are indefinite and additional charges last 10 seconds each.
Each Soul Charge grants +[254.04] Attack Rating.
At 10+ Soul Charges: Guillotine becomes Unshackled, enhancing her Special Attacks until she's back below 6 Charges.

abilitySections.title: Critical Hits
content: 35% chance to inflict a Bleed Debuff, causing [2,963.8] direct damage over 5 seconds. Chance increases by a flat +5% for each Buff on the opponent.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: 100% chance to inflict a 10 second Bleed Curse Debuff.
An opponent with a Bleed Curse suffers a Bleed Debuff, causing [3,810.6] direct damage over 5 seconds, each time they're struck with a Special Attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: Unshackled: Guillotine is Passively Unblockable during the attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Final hit has a 100% chance to inflict a Pain Link Debuff lasting 10 seconds. While active, any Non-Physical damage taken by Guillotine is also inflicted on the opponent as Physical Damage.
Unshackled: Spend 10 Souls to apply an additional Pain Link Debuff when launching the attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Final hit has a 100% chance to inflict a Spectre Debuff for 10 seconds, reducing Regeneration Rate by 200%.
Unshackled: Spend 10 Souls to Pause the Spectre for 10 seconds when it is first activated.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% chance to inflict a Degeneration Debuff causing [2,963.8] direct damage over 3 seconds. Then consume all Soul Charges to increase the Degeneration duration by +3 seconds for each Soul spent this way.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Cursed Aura
content: Whenever the opponent is Immune to Guillotine's personal Bleed effects, she has a [60 - 100]% chance to inflict a matching Rupture Debuff, causing Physical Damage. This Rupture Debuff grants 1 Soul Charge.
